question: Which of the following movements was founded in Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is** Ramakrishna Mission**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ramakrishna Mission** was founded by Swami Vivekananda in 1897.
 
• It was established in the honor of his guru, Sri Ramakrishna Paramhansa, aiming at the spiritual and social upliftment of humanity.
 
• The mission promotes Vedanta and works on principles of Karma Yoga.
 
• It has played a significant role in the education and health sectors in India, including relief and rehabilitation work during disasters.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 2) Arya Samaj
 Founded by Swami Dayananda Saraswati in 1875, Arya Samaj promotes values and practices based on the infallibility of the Vedas.
 
 

 3) Satyashodhak Samaj
 Founded by Jyotirao Phule in 1873 in Maharashtra, it aimed at social reform including the upliftment of the oppressed classes in India.
 
 

 4) Prarthana Samaj
 Established by Dr. Atmaram Pandurang in 1867 with an aim to make social reforms in Hindu society, it was influenced by the Brahmo Samaj.
